# evidence_planning fixtures: recorded public inputs for the three-cell path replay

Independent copies of the public inputs each cell's kernel received, so the
replay tests never read `artifacts/` or `.dig/`. Every value here was taken
from the recorded run; nothing is synthesised except the seq44 lineage record
described below, which the real extractor produced from that run's frozen
manifest because the run itself never collected it.
